title: New 'Ghost in the Shell' TV Anime Announces Supporting Cast Pair
content: The official website for the new Koukaku Kidoutai ( The Ghost in the Shell ) television anime announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The new TV anime premiered on July 7 at 11:00 p.m. on Kansai TV and Fuji TV affiliates.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Kenshi Yonezu, Tōko Miura, Yōko Kuno Join Live-Action Look Back Film as Special Guest Staff
content: The official website for the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga announced on Thursday that musician Kenshi Yonezu , actress and singer Tōko Miura , and animator and director Yōko Kuno will have special guest staff roles in the film.
author: ANN

title: Love Is Like a Cocktail's Crystal na Yōsuke Launches Romantic Comedy Manga
content: The September issue of Shogakukan 's Monthly Sunday Gene-X magazine announced on Wednesday that Crystal na Yōsuke will launch a new series titled Tokoro de Machi Chūka wa Date ni Irimasu ka? (By the Way, Is the Local Chinese Restaurant a Date Spot?) in the next issue on September 18.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia Might Never Return With a New Anime, But Fans Already Have a Perfect Replacement
content: After the release of its latest anime short this month, it’s evident that My Hero Academi a won’t be returning with a new episode or series. As of now, the series has adapted all the content from Kohei Horikoshi, including the extra chapter and one-shot.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 New 2026 Anime That Everyone Should Watch Before the Year Ends
content: It’s hard to believe we’ve already blown past the halfway point of 2026, but the year has brought audiences incredible anime releases over its first eight months. From Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s Culling Game arc to the final chapter of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War , there’s no shortage of great content to enjoy.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Action Fantasy Returns With a Surprise Isekai Crossover Ahead of Season 3
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword is easily the hottest action fantasy on Crunchyroll right now, but fans will have to wait a while before the third season. Thanks to the popularity of the anime, a season 3 was confirmed right along with the second season finale in June this year.

title: 'Wareware wa Uchuujin' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website of the Wareware wa Uchuujin ( We Are Aliens ) announced additional cast on Thursday. The film is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on September 25.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Live-Action S and X: Confession of Therapist Series Streams 1st 2 Minutes
content: Netflix began streaming the first two minutes from the live-action series of Kisei Tada 's S and X: Confession of Therapist ( S to X ~Therapist Shimotori Ichito no Kokuhaku) manga for free on Thursday.
author: ANN
